ctx.x: Yeah. And we went to Selma, moved to Selma because she got this teaching job in this school here. It was a little school, Paine University. And she went there and then she got married there, and she got a band. So she quit teaching school when she got married, and the only thing she did was just play dances and we would travel all around the state, you know. And I was part of the band, you know.
